- Tue 03/02 09:00–10:00

Jordan — thanks for the diagram. A couple of quick reads on my end before the session would help me prepare:
- expected egress throughput (Mbps) between NutriWorks VPC and Redwood Dedicated (or time-bucketed TPS if you prefer)
- whether you plan to use private connectivity (Direct Connect / ExpressRoute) or a VPN concentrator
- KMS preference (customer-managed key vs. Redwood-managed key)

If you can drop those into the Drive folder (or paste here), I’ll prepare a short topology slide + a sample iptables/route table example we typically use for VPC peering.

Also, for the IAM piece — are you using an IdP (Okta/ADFS) for role mapping, or are you planning to rely on token exchange? That will change the demo bits I bring.
